# Bridgetown AI

> Portland, Oregon AI consulting practice run by Sean Teisher. Sean has 26 years in IT, including nearly two decades as VP of IT at New Seasons Market. He helps small businesses use AI agents and proves a solution works on their real workflow before they pay.

## How it works
1. Free 30-minute call about how the business runs.
2. A working pilot on one real task.
3. The client sees the results and decides whether to keep, change, or walk away.
4. Grow what works, with optional ongoing management.

## Ways to work together
- Consulting: where AI fits, what to skip, which tools are worth it
- Team training: hands-on, safe use of ChatGPT, Claude and other tools
- Custom AI agents: phone and booking assistant, Google review responder, bookkeeping helper, lead follow-up
- Ongoing agent management: monitoring, tuning and updates

Pricing is shaped per client after the free call. There are no published prices.

## Tools
Hermes · Grok Bot · OpenClaw · Claude & Claude Code · ChatGPT & Codex · Muse · Google Workspace · Microsoft 365
